name: lorekeeper
description: LanceDB-backed long-term memory service for Hermes — self-contained fork of opencode-memory-pro v1.6.2 (MIT).

scripts.vendor:sync: rsync -a --delete /root/.hermes/workspace/opencode-memory-pro/dist/ vendor/dist/ && cp /root/.hermes/workspace/opencode-memory-pro/LICENSE vendor/ 2>/dev/null; cp /root/.hermes/workspace/opencode-memory-pro/opencode-memory-pro.example.json vendor/lorekeeper.example.json 2>/dev/null && sed -i 's/opencode-memory-pro\\.example\\.json/lorekeeper.example.json/; s/opencode\\/opencode-memory-pro\\.json/opencode\\/lorekeeper.json/g; s/opencode-memory-pro/Lorekeeper/g' vendor/lorekeeper.example.json 2>/dev/null; echo 'vendor synced'
